description: The Transform package provides foundational building blocks for converting data between different formats in your OOMOL workflow. Whether you are working with strings, binary data, or JSON objects, these modules can help you seamlessly convert data between various formats.
encodes-a-string-to-binary-and-then-deco: Encodes a string to binary and then decodes it back to a string
converts-a-json-object-to-a-string-and-t: Converts a JSON object to a string and then parses it back to JSON
the-decoding-format-of-the-string-if-not: The decoding format of the string, if not filled, it will be automatically recognized
extract-the-object-and-split-it-into-spe: Extract the object and split it into specific fields
if-enabled-the-fields-in-the-object-extr: If enabled, the fields in the object extracted this time are exactly in the list. If there are fields outside the list, an error will be reported.
parse-a-json-string-into-a-json-object: Parse a JSON string into a JSON object
if-it-is-0-there-is-no-carriage-return-a: If it is 0, there is no carriage return and indentation. If it is greater than 0, there is a carriage return, and the number of spaces for indentation is the same as this number.
if-on-all-characters-are-ascii-non-ascii: If on, all characters are ASCII (non-ASCII characters are escaped).
